traces.title: Wrong unit of work: testcase catalogue instead of rule repair
traces.source_observation: The deliverable was corrected from a per-case question catalogue to individual rule changes; the final README retires the earlier catalogue.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Accounting for every benchmark error is equivalent to producing reusable rules.
traces.consequence: Task failure and label/template fitting; no direct FP/FN rate follows.
traces.generalized_invariant: The authoring unit is the reusable security mechanism and responsible rule; benchmark cases are development evidence.
traces.authoring_action: State the requested deliverable, exact rule identity, reusable mechanism, and non-goals before dividing work. Permit repair, reuse, investigation, and no-rule outcomes.
traces.acceptance_test: Give an authoring agent several differently named cases with one mechanism. Require one justified rule-level change rather than case-specific questions or predicates.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: A case ledger is useful and should remain; it must not replace mechanism-level reasoning or be passed as runtime truth.

traces.title: Unverified source-shape diagnosis in delegated work
traces.source_observation: Coordinator assignments confused nested pathlib effects with match/case cases. Workers inspected source, corrected the grouping, and also retracted an initially guessed alternative grouping.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A case ID, category, or summary establishes the exact cause of a miss.
traces.consequence: Wrong model repairs, gaps, duplicate ownership, and anchoring on a false diagnosis.
traces.generalized_invariant: Diagnosis is evidence-backed and separately marked from hypothesis; ownership follows the actual mechanism.
traces.authoring_action: Attach source hash/location and a concrete observation to each assignment. Require workers to correct contradictions before implementing and preserve correction history.
traces.acceptance_test: Present a misleading summary with a source whose mechanism differs. Require an explicit correction and unchanged original evidence.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not require one coordinator to duplicate every worker investigation; require evidence-linked hypotheses and a correction channel.

traces.title: Historical schema used as the active contract
traces.source_observation: Work initially used profile 0.3 despite the active profile-0.4 runtime. Migration also exposed five purpose/decision-role mismatches, later corrected.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: An archived schema or a parsed contract is compatible with the current executor.
traces.consequence: Blocked integration or changed execution semantics; not automatically a vulnerability miss.
traces.generalized_invariant: Engine, rule syntax, local contract, provider payload, and execution mode are distinct pinned interfaces.
traces.authoring_action: Read the installed runtime/schema and one real consumer before authoring. Freeze a shared interface receipt for workers and version migrations explicitly.
traces.acceptance_test: Reject an old profile and mismatched role pair at preflight; validate the migrated payload through the actual consumer.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not silently upgrade the engine or erase archived artifacts to make compatibility appear successful.

traces.title: Unsafe and boundary cases encoded as ordinary ok tests
traces.source_observation: Several fixtures used ok annotations for known unsafe noncoverage or companion-owned cases. The parent replaced them with explicit boundary/discovery records and separate failing expectations.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A test expecting no match establishes a safe security negative.
traces.consequence: False confidence in recall and contaminated negative counts.
traces.generalized_invariant: Matcher admission, security truth, scope membership, and observed execution are independent fields.
traces.authoring_action: Maintain a structured sidecar with those four fields. Known unsafe in-scope omissions remain failing recall obligations; boundary cases never satisfy the safe-negative minimum.
traces.acceptance_test: Audit a fixture containing an unsafe callback under ok. Fail the semantic gate even if the native matcher test is green; keep a legitimate safe admitted candidate distinct.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Native ok denotes nonmatching syntax, not a native security verdict. Archived educational boundaries may remain unchanged with explicit interpretation.

traces.title: Conditional factory premise promoted to definite vulnerability truth
traces.source_observation: Opaque factory cases are conditional on returning LDAP/lxml objects, yet some bookkeeping describes them as unsafe security misses without supplying that binding.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A similarly named consumer on an unknown object is an independently established vulnerability.
traces.consequence: False positive labels and overstated FN counts.
traces.generalized_invariant: A test proves only its supplied premises; missing bindings are not supplied by comments or desired labels.
traces.authoring_action: Provide a concrete caller/factory body or an explicit justified educational API contract; otherwise classify as conditional/unresolved applicability.
traces.acceptance_test: Use two concrete factories with the same method spelling, one relevant and one unrelated, plus a third absent factory. Require distinct justified labels.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: A conditional discovery challenge remains useful and must not be relabeled safe or deleted.

traces.title: Security labels generated from function names
traces.source_observation: Parent bookkeeping derives unsafe/safe status from function names beginning with unsafe_ and from special named functions. This is authoring metadata, not evidence that the runtime model received these labels.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A naming convention is a semantic oracle.
traces.consequence: Mislabeling renamed, mixed-purpose, or incorrectly named tests; circular validation.
traces.generalized_invariant: Truth labels require a claim-specific rationale independent of the representation being tested.
traces.authoring_action: Store reviewed labels and assumptions explicitly. Names may identify a record but cannot determine its security truth.
traces.acceptance_test: Rename safe and unsafe functions without changing behavior. Semantic labels and aggregate counts must remain unchanged.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not accuse runtime prompt leakage from this step alone; it demonstrates an authoring-label construction risk.

traces.title: Free-text status variants evade the boundary collector
traces.source_observation: A collector filters security_status == unsafe while worker records use unsafe_outside_scope; later code broadens classification and repairs boundary fixtures.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Unvalidated status strings from multiple workers form a consistent interface.
traces.consequence: Known gaps can disappear from the required regression population.
traces.generalized_invariant: Machine-consumed states are a closed, versioned vocabulary with independent scope and truth fields.
traces.authoring_action: Validate handoffs. Reject unknown enum values; do not infer scope from substrings in prose or overload one status field.
traces.acceptance_test: Submit all supported statuses plus an unknown spelling; require conservation of every case and rejection of the unknown spelling.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not standardize by silently mapping every unsafe-prefixed label to definite vulnerability truth.

traces.title: Observation fields initialized from expectation
traces.source_observation: An intermediate discovery record writes observed_native_match=False while also requiring a runtime observation. Later records are reconciled to native reported lines.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A known or expected failure on related evidence is the observation for this exact retained fixture/run.
traces.consequence: Invented receipts and erroneous promotion or failure accounting.
traces.generalized_invariant: Observed fields start unknown and are populated only from matching captures for the exact artifact.
traces.authoring_action: Keep expected and observed values separate; require capture identity and source/rule digests for every observation.
traces.acceptance_test: Before execution, observed values remain null. Feed a contradictory native report and ensure the report, not the expectation, determines observation.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Historical observations may be retained with their original identity; do not overwrite them with null or pretend they are fresh.

traces.title: Uncertainty removed by searching prose
traces.source_observation: remaining_gaps entries containing missing or unreported are removed after candidate emission; other limitations are removed by phrases such as not measured.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Finding a candidate resolves every uncertainty whose text sounds like noncompletion.
traces.consequence: Missing caller/runtime/control evidence can be hidden; exact lost statements are not established without private ledgers.
traces.generalized_invariant: An uncertainty closes only through evidence that resolves that identified uncertainty.
traces.authoring_action: Use stable gap IDs with typed resolution events, evidence refs, scope, and reviewer rationale. Preserve superseded text/history.
traces.acceptance_test: Resolve a discovery gap while leaving missing-runtime and missing-consumer gaps. Only the discovery ID may close, regardless of their wording.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not infer that all removed statements were material; the unsafe operation is visible but its full downstream impact is not.

traces.title: Rendered source copied as authoritative bytes
traces.source_observation: A ranged raw read included a human pagination footer; copying it created invalid Python. The author reread the complete file and parsed it before retaining the fixture.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Displayed or nominally raw tool text is necessarily a complete source artifact.
traces.consequence: False parser diagnoses, damaged fixtures, or changes to analyzed semantics.
traces.generalized_invariant: Artifact bytes are distinct from previews; complete extraction and deliberate transformations require verifiable identity.
traces.authoring_action: Read actual bytes or honor continuation metadata. Validate syntax and exact intended changes without stripping arbitrary source lines that resemble footers.
traces.acceptance_test: Inject a truncated preview/footer into a source transfer. Reject it rather than treating the resulting parse failure as an engine limitation.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Syntax success is necessary but not proof of byte identity or preserved behavior.

traces.title: Filter-only alternative rejected by native schema
traces.source_observation: The new pathlib rule placed metavariable-pattern directly in an alternative in a form the native schema rejected. A positive pattern plus filter conjunction repaired that branch.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A plausible shared-syntax construct is accepted by the selected native parser in every syntactic position.
traces.consequence: Configuration failure can prevent the entire selected pack from scanning.
traces.generalized_invariant: Every matcher branch and referenced metavariable must have a supported positive binding and pass the exact engine interface.
traces.authoring_action: Run a small native schema/construct check before full-pack integration; inspect the underlying stdout/stderr when the test report itself is invalid.
traces.acceptance_test: Exercise each branch in isolation, its conjunction, and the full pack. Require intended rule count, no skipped/invalid rule, and positive/negative controls.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: This failure does not imply that metavariable-pattern or focus is generally broken.

traces.title: Keyword spelling substituted for effective argument binding
traces.source_observation: The cookie model tests keyword presence and excludes keyword expansion, leaving positional Secure and statically resolvable expansions insufficiently challenged.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Absence of a keyword establishes the effective default, or any expansion is safe to exclude.
traces.consequence: Potential FP for positional true and FN for resolvable missing/false Secure.
traces.generalized_invariant: Security-relevant configuration follows the resolved API signature and effective arguments, not one spelling.
traces.authoring_action: Build a version-bound argument model covering supported positional, keyword, default, alias, and expansion forms; preserve unknowns.
traces.acceptance_test: Contrast equivalent positional/keyword calls, missing/false/true values, a literal dictionary expansion, and an unknown mapping. Run responsible rule and pack.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: These are proposed native regressions, not reproduced emissions here; do not apply one API signature to unrelated receivers.

traces.title: Whole-call or whole-object taint substituted for the dangerous operand
traces.source_observation: The analyses distinguish response bodies from headers/status, shell program text from ordinary argv/cwd/env, and query grammar from other parameters. Several broad candidates intentionally retain these distinctions for later analysis.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Any taint in the call or receiver proves taint in the security-relevant operand.
traces.consequence: False positives and incorrect security claims.
traces.generalized_invariant: The consumed operand, its role, and its program point are explicit and preserved end to end.
traces.authoring_action: Resolve the relevant argument/receiver/field and focus the matcher or procedural check accordingly; do not merge unrelated taint labels as evidence.
traces.acceptance_test: Move the same untrusted value between dangerous and inert operands while holding all other facts fixed; verify expected differentiation.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: An inert operand for one claim may matter to another; do not classify the whole call safe.

traces.title: Earlier constructor treated as current receiver identity
traces.source_observation: Bounded constructor ancestry and broad reassignment exclusions try to separate Path from unrelated in-memory receivers, but a later assignment can still be a relevant Path.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Either historical constructor presence proves identity now, or reassignment removes all security relevance.
traces.consequence: FP from stale identity or FN from legitimate unsafe reassignment.
traces.generalized_invariant: Identity is a reaching program-state fact; syntax history is only candidate evidence.
traces.authoring_action: Resolve supported reaching definitions; represent unresolved identity without a safety verdict. Record an explicit recall cost for any exclusion.
traces.acceptance_test: Test Path to unrelated object, unrelated object to Path, trusted Path to untrusted Path, aliases, and conditional reassignments.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not require arbitrary runtime dispatch to be solved; bounded support and explicit unknowns are legitimate.

traces.title: Stale tuple shape used at response consumption
traces.source_observation: Tuple-specific patterns and exclusions refer to earlier assignments; later replacements can change both type and body provenance before return.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: An earlier tuple assignment determines the object and element consumed later.
traces.consequence: Potential FN for tuple-to-tainted-string and FP for tainted-tuple-to-trusted replacement.
traces.generalized_invariant: Classification uses the final reaching value and relevant slot at the actual consumer.
traces.authoring_action: Test type and provenance transitions in both directions; separate construction-site reporting from use-site reasoning.
traces.acceptance_test: Cover tuple to string, string to tuple, tuple to response, body/header swaps, and safe overwrite after unsafe construction.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not suppress all tuples or assume all response constructors obey Flask tuple semantics.

traces.title: Control-flow syntax mistaken for path feasibility
traces.source_observation: Match-owner candidates address reported join/lowering gaps. A final wildcard assignment is not an all-path overwrite after an earlier selected arm.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Textual last assignment or lexical coexistence with a match statement establishes execution order and feasible flow.
traces.consequence: FN from false all-path overwrite; FP from incompatible or unreachable arms.
traces.generalized_invariant: Needed facts must hold on compatible feasible paths under the relevant language semantics.
traces.authoring_action: Use supported procedural control-flow reasoning, preserve unsupported guards/objects, and describe structural owner candidates honestly.
traces.acceptance_test: Contrast constant-selected unsafe/safe arms, guarded arms, post-match unconditional overwrite, and an unrelated nested match.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: A single probe does not prove the engine has no support for every match/case construct.

traces.title: Sanitizer property does not survive a context change
traces.source_observation: jsonify is modeled as a sanitizer while later effective MIME and response mutation are relevant to the claimed XSS result.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A transformation that is safe in its initial context remains safe after reinterpretation or mutation.
traces.consequence: Potential false negatives before any later assessor sees a candidate.
traces.generalized_invariant: Safety is a property of the representation at the actual effect, preserved through all relevant subsequent transformations.
traces.authoring_action: Describe sanitizer preconditions, postcondition, representation, context, and invalidating operations. Avoid irreversible taint removal when those conditions are not established.
traces.acceptance_test: Compare unchanged JSON delivery with later HTML interpretation, safe encoding with later decoding, and the same value in text versus script context.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not ban jsonify or every sanitizer; validate the contexts in which the summary is sufficient.

traces.title: Control presence mistaken for enforcement or authorized trust
traces.source_observation: The reviewed guidance correctly distinguishes returned versus in-place sanitization, checks on the consumed value, signed storage versus authorized request data, and post-effect catches.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A check exists, a token is signed, or the user is authenticated; therefore this effect is authorized and prevented on rejection.
traces.consequence: False negatives from unenforced, wrong-subject, or insufficient controls.
traces.generalized_invariant: A control must enforce the required property on the same value/resource/principal before the effect, with valid coverage and trust assumptions.
traces.authoring_action: Write the control postcondition and failure path explicitly; accept alternative controls that establish the same property, including valid compositions.
traces.acceptance_test: Challenge discarded return values, log-only failures, caught rejection with continuation, wrong principal/resource, and a valid alternative control.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not demand one particular guard or one dominating check if a correct all-path composition exists.

traces.title: Construction confused with effect or lazy consumption
traces.source_observation: The review distinguishes deferred YAML iteration, compiled XPath invocation, response delivery, and a filesystem read that occurs before slicing/escaping its result.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Constructing a sensitive object proves the effect occurred, or processing its result later retroactively prevents the earlier effect.
traces.consequence: FP from never-consumed objects and FN from post-effect apparent controls.
traces.generalized_invariant: Identify the precise effect stage, evaluation order, and actual consumption under the declared API semantics.
traces.authoring_action: Model creation, execution/iteration, delivery, mutation, and cleanup as distinct stages where material; retain call/use identities.
traces.acceptance_test: Pair used versus unused lazy results, invoked versus uninvoked query objects, sent versus discarded responses, and inner effect before outer transformation.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not assume every constructor is effect-free; inspect the actual API.

traces.title: Taint or grammar influence promoted to unauthorized impact
traces.source_observation: The material separates query grammar from permitted query-language use, mock LDAP from production impact, weak primitives from security reliance, and metadata queries from file-content access.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A sensitive API, attacker-selected grammar, external URL, or persisted value is automatically a vulnerability with the strongest possible impact.
traces.consequence: False positives, overstated impact, and faulty labels.
traces.generalized_invariant: Observation, necessary security premises, authorization policy, and claimed consequence are separate; no stage silently strengthens the claim.
traces.authoring_action: Declare permitted behavior and required security property independently. Preserve separate claims for shell, argv, XXE, expansion, headers, and authority.
traces.acceptance_test: Contrast deliberately permitted query interfaces, authorized external destinations, nonsecurity digests, signed but unauthorized state, and metadata-only effects.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not require production exploitation proof for a deliberately narrower audit claim; label the claim honestly.

traces.title: Request-derived value treated as unrestricted attacker syntax
traces.source_observation: The earlier review distinguishes HTTP header names from unrestricted header values and flags route-converter/accepted-domain evidence as material.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Every request field or route parameter admits all syntax necessary for the proposed exploit.
traces.consequence: False positives from infeasible characters/domains; false negatives if restrictions are assumed without evidence.
traces.generalized_invariant: Attacker influence is qualified by the actual accepted domain and transformations into the consumed representation.
traces.authoring_action: Record source kind, converters, parsing, normalization, and enforced rejection. Validate a proposed witness through each earlier restriction.
traces.acceptance_test: Use identical downstream code with a finite converter, a constrained header-name source, and an unrestricted value source; preserve unknown deployment acceptance.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not assume protocol restrictions alone prove complete application safety or silently change native labels.

traces.title: Unconditional slice sources erase provenance distinctions
traces.source_observation: Slice-result expressions are admitted as sources to compensate for reported native taint loss, including trusted producers.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A slice candidate is a proved request origin or a repaired taint transfer.
traces.consequence: Candidate false alarms and review cost; possible misclassification if provenance is treated as fact.
traces.generalized_invariant: Candidate provenance retains which facts were observed, approximated, or remain unknown.
traces.authoring_action: Distinguish native may-flow, structural inventory, and unresolved-provenance candidates; resolve supported provenance procedurally before residual assessment.
traces.acceptance_test: Use identical slice shapes on trusted and untrusted producers and an overwritten slice; verify provenance and dispositions remain distinct.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: A broad candidate is not automatically a bad rule; its downstream evidence burden and workload must be measured.

traces.title: Container-wide propagation loses key and field relationships
traces.source_observation: Generic append/extend/update propagation can conservatively taint an entire container or receiver after one write.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: The selected element at the sink is necessarily the tainted one, or removing one element clears the whole object.
traces.consequence: False positives or false negatives from unsupported element precision.
traces.generalized_invariant: The model must state its precision for elements, keys, fields, aliases, and mutation; later decisions cannot assume greater precision.
traces.authoring_action: Resolve supported selections and distinguish receiver mutation from returned values. Preserve imprecision in the evidence supplied downstream.
traces.acceptance_test: Mix clean/dirty entries, access different keys, overwrite or remove an entry, alias the container, and place taint only in a non-dangerous argument.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not claim index sensitivity from a one-element teaching fixture.

traces.title: Narrow replacement silently retires broader discovery
traces.source_observation: A generic deserialization audit is retired in favor of a Flask-focused source model plus match-specific companions; non-Flask sources are acknowledged as outside the replacement.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Keeping prior benchmark TP files proves the replacement preserves the original supported mechanisms.
traces.consequence: Cross-repository false negatives and silent coverage loss.
traces.generalized_invariant: Every retired behavior has an explicit successor, justified claim exclusion, declared product scope change, or retained unresolved coverage debt.
traces.authoring_action: Create a coverage handoff table and test lost shapes with the effective selection. Preserve broader discovery where replacement adequacy is unproved.
traces.acceptance_test: Add non-Flask inputs with and without match/case and verify exact-operation coverage under old, new, and combined intended selections.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not keep a false broad audit forever merely because it is old; separate noisy audit policy from missing vulnerability discovery.

traces.title: Companion ownership asserted without same-operation verification
traces.source_observation: Cases excluded by one rule are designated companion-scope. One intermediate regression mistakenly required the excluded constructor case from the route rule before being corrected.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Naming a companion proves the emitted operation is covered, or every rule must cover the whole family independently.
traces.consequence: Hidden pack-level FN or wrongly failing rule-local requirements; duplicate votes can mask ownership errors.
traces.generalized_invariant: Rule-local scope and selected-pack security coverage are different contracts joined by exact operation identity.
traces.authoring_action: Record which selected rule owns each delegated effect and verify its actual emitted location and claim. Retain overlapping evidence without duplicate vulnerability votes.
traces.acceptance_test: Run a constructor/route-return overlap case individually and as a pack; require at least one correct owner, no uncovered delegation, and a declared deduplication rule.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not force all companions to match every unsafe case or declare pack recovery from any same-file alert.

traces.title: Coverage learned from one spelling rather than API behavior
traces.source_observation: The pack retains gaps for hash callbacks, runtime-selected algorithms, Random instances, stored bound methods, and factory-returned receivers.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Matching an API name or one constructor form establishes coverage of the security mechanism.
traces.consequence: False negatives on equivalent implementations.
traces.generalized_invariant: The supported surface is explicit across call forms, factories, callbacks, instances, and analysis boundaries.
traces.authoring_action: Inventory common equivalent shapes and test them; a limitation remains in broader recall accounting even when outside a narrow matcher.
traces.acceptance_test: Hold the mechanism fixed while varying imported alias, keyword form, stored callable, instance method, helper, and factory; bind any required callers concretely.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not broaden to arbitrary same-named calls or claim every possible dynamic form must be solved before any bounded rule is useful.

traces.title: Contract input types incompatible with benchmark selectors
traces.source_observation: Four crypto/randomness contracts require strings while the standard benchmark selector interface permits mapped JSON inputs only; omitting mappings leaves required inputs unavailable.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Standalone schema/planner validity proves compatibility with the production evidence adapter.
traces.consequence: Execution blocker and unavailable assessments, not a justified static or safe result.
traces.generalized_invariant: Evidence producers and actual consumers agree on types, meaning, identity, and execution capability.
traces.authoring_action: Exercise real contract-to-runner bindings using actual producer outputs before expanding the pack. Changing a type name alone does not supply the missing evidence.
traces.acceptance_test: Use each authored contract with the real adapter: reject incompatible ports, assert explicit missingness, and verify a complete actual binding reaches the expected request.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: The generic planner may legitimately support strings; the incompatibility is with this particular adapter.

traces.title: Test adapted to contract instead of exercising actual integration
traces.source_observation: A synthetic preparation loop first asserts JSON input and fails on operation_source:string, then is changed to supply either strings or JSON. The saved result remains explicitly a planner-shape smoke.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Making the smoke data fit declared port types resolves the real benchmark interface failure.
traces.consequence: Integration defect survives a passing unit demonstration.
traces.generalized_invariant: A component test cannot certify an interface path it bypasses.
traces.authoring_action: Keep the generic planner smoke, but add a distinct real-adapter integration test whose inputs come from the actual producer. Label each test by its boundary.
traces.acceptance_test: Give all contracts the same irrelevant shell snippet: the shape smoke may pass, but a semantic/evidence integration gate must not declare target assessment readiness.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: No fabricated model answers are shown in this smoke; the mistake is overinterpreting its coverage, not the legitimate use of synthetic data.

traces.title: Input presence mistaken for semantic sufficiency
traces.source_observation: Some prompts assign missing essentials to blocked while their Choice only represents unsafe/constrained/unresolved and defines unresolved as ambiguity after evidence supply.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A populated field implies the needed implementation, configuration, or complete consumers are present.
traces.consequence: Potential false refutation, unsupported positive, or avoidable blocked work.
traces.generalized_invariant: Execution status is separate from claim assessment; semantic incompleteness inside present inputs remains unresolved.
traces.authoring_action: Define exact evidence requirements and completeness limits. Allow decision-dependent sufficient evidence; do not require irrelevant fields after a decisive narrow refutation.
traces.acceptance_test: Supply a present callers object missing the relevant helper; require unresolved. Separately provide a decisive non-relevant API binding and avoid demanding unrelated downstream evidence.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not claim a runtime can mechanically prove arbitrary semantic completeness.

traces.title: Descriptive metadata mistaken for model-visible evidence
traces.source_observation: The runtime sends bound state and question instructions/criteria; claim, scope, assumptions, tags, and graph edges do not automatically supply source evidence.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Writing an assumption in the contract or adding a parent node ensures the model sees it.
traces.consequence: Wrong-scope decisions, missing premises, and anchoring on unsupported prior classifications.
traces.generalized_invariant: Every material premise is traceable through actual input, state binding, serialized request, answer, and permitted decision use.
traces.authoring_action: Inspect rendered payloads. Bind underlying source separately from fallible parent answers; pin identities and invalidate descendants when required evidence changes.
traces.acceptance_test: Remove an essential scope binding; block or remain unresolved. Change parent evidence without changing its categorical answer and require stale-child invalidation.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not add every contract field to every prompt; include what the question actually needs and avoid leakage.

traces.title: Nonexclusive or incomplete answer domains and mixed consumers
traces.source_observation: Protected crypto outcomes are not equally explicit about every relevant security consumer/path, while one object can feed both protected and unprotected uses.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: One protected use refutes the operation-level claim, or absence of an unsafe witness chooses the safe category.
traces.consequence: Model-induced false negatives or forced classification when no option fits.
traces.generalized_invariant: Answer categories match one scoped proposition; existential support and all-scope refutation have different obligations.
traces.authoring_action: Define precedence for a supported unsafe witness, complete refutation, not-applicable situations, and unresolved evidence. Avoid forcing compatible attributes into exclusive choices.
traces.acceptance_test: Use mixed protected/unprotected consumers, one safe branch plus one unknown branch, a non-relevant API, and incompatible control mechanisms that jointly suffice.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not require knowledge of every branch to accept one fully established unsafe witness.

traces.title: Independent answers combined into a nonexistent joint witness
traces.source_observation: The reviews warn that decomposition and marginal probabilities do not by themselves retain relational facts across paths, values, and principals.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Some attacker control plus some failed control anywhere implies one feasible unauthorized effect.
traces.consequence: False positives from incompatible paths; false negatives from a safe answer about a different subject.
traces.generalized_invariant: Composition preserves operation, value/version, principal/resource, configuration, and compatible path or explicit consumer coverage.
traces.authoring_action: Attach relational identities to premise records and compose only justified relations. Treat procedural/model conflicts as evidence-review conditions, not votes.
traces.acceptance_test: Place source influence and failed enforcement on mutually exclusive branches, then move them to the same feasible branch; require different outcomes.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: A single holistic question is not automatically wrong, and more nodes are not automatically safer.

traces.title: Raw confidence or low unsafe probability used as safety
traces.source_observation: The reviewed system is shadow-only and has no live model evaluation. The reviews distinguish native Choice confidence from measured decision error.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: High confidence in unresolved, low P(unsafe), or a shared threshold across different domains justifies suppression.
traces.consequence: Future model-induced FN and misleading calibration claims.
traces.generalized_invariant: Only a separately validated claim-refutation policy can authorize dismissal; uncertainty is not a negative vote.
traces.authoring_action: Freeze output semantics and decision policy, evaluate false dismissals on the actual residual population, and report uncertainty/dependence.
traces.acceptance_test: Feed supported=.01/refuted=.02/unresolved=.97 and require retained review. Change option count/order without pretending a fixed confidence threshold has invariant error.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: No actual suppression failure is established here; do not invent a measured error rate or a universal safe threshold.

traces.title: Source labels and instructions treated as authoritative evidence
traces.source_observation: The executor can transmit source text; mechanical guardrails reject recognized hints but explicitly do not claim to catch all leakage or insufficient evidence.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Target-only context is automatically label-neutral and safe to interpret as instructions.
traces.consequence: Label leakage, misleading evaluation, and source-driven decision manipulation.
traces.generalized_invariant: Source and retrieved content are untrusted evidence; authoring expectations and instructions are not decision authority.
traces.authoring_action: Separate oracle/patch/contrast materials, review any transformation with a reverse map, and test comment-only steering without deleting semantic program content.
traces.acceptance_test: Add irrelevant comments asking for a safe verdict, rename benchmark identifiers, remove decisive helper evidence, and assert no unwarranted dismissal.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not claim regex filtering proves absence of leakage; do not strip code or required annotations blindly.

traces.title: Candidate volume, duplicates and budgets treated as harmless
traces.source_observation: Broad candidates overlap, and the executor uses a shared request budget while the reported scan has thousands of raw findings.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Candidate-only status removes false-positive cost, or one duplicate surviving proves every underlying decision was correct.
traces.consequence: Review overload, budget-exhausted assessments, masked erroneous dismissals, and inflated votes.
traces.generalized_invariant: Unique operations, rule claims, underlying findings, routing decisions, and capacity limits remain separately measurable.
traces.authoring_action: Measure workload and overlap; use declared identity-aware deduplication and scheduling while preserving raw evidence and budget-exhaustion status.
traces.acceptance_test: Create duplicates of one operation plus a distinct later operation under a small budget. Require stable declared scheduling and visible unassessed work without extra TP votes.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Budget exhaustion is an execution outcome, not automatically an FN/TN; report its practical coverage consequence separately.

traces.title: Green subset mistaken for completed analysis or release readiness
traces.source_observation: check.py runs direct rule/fixture pairs; separate discovery regressions fail and native validation remains blocked. The final documentation correctly withholds readiness.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Exit zero, scanned-file presence, or 21 passing pairs means all required behavior passed.
traces.consequence: Undetected regression, false coverage, or premature release claims.
traces.generalized_invariant: Each gate certifies only the exercised surface, and promotion considers the union of required obligations.
traces.authoring_action: Maintain a gate manifest for syntax, branches, full source, responsible rule, whole pack, required discovery, adapter, and independent evaluation. Mark out-of-scope obligations separately, never as passes.
traces.acceptance_test: Let the bounded suite pass while one required discovery or integration check fails; promotion must fail with the correct gate and retained diagnostics.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not turn every conditional challenge into an absolute release failure without first establishing its applicability and required scope.

traces.title: Same-file candidate associations promoted to detection recovery
traces.source_observation: The development ledger joins by file and associated rule; prior TP retention uses expected-CWE presence in the file. The final report explicitly calls these candidate observations.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Any associated same-file candidate is the original unsafe sink, a recovered vulnerability, or an independently scored positive.
traces.consequence: Misleading recall/precision, wrong-CWE credit, and duplicated outcomes.
traces.generalized_invariant: Scoring preserves the declared oracle unit and mapping; candidate/location association is a different measurement.
traces.authoring_action: Keep testcase/CWE scores frozen and separate localized operation studies that require independent labels. Do not fix CWE disagreements by label-fitting remaps.
traces.acceptance_test: Include two same-file operations, duplicate alerts, wrong-CWE alerts, and one true labeled unit; require declared aggregation without manufactured votes.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: The existing counts are not fraudulent when presented at their actual candidate-association level.

traces.title: Development success mistaken for generalization or model value
traces.source_observation: No live JEV study or independent cross-repository evaluation is reported; previous TP/TN populations and template dependence matter to any future gain claim.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Fixing development FP/FN rows or adding richer evidence proves the decision model improves detection.
traces.consequence: Hidden new FP/lost TP, overfit rules/questions, and confounded attribution.
traces.generalized_invariant: Evaluate native baseline, native repair, procedural augmentation, and residual model addition separately with matched evidence and frozen policy.
traces.authoring_action: Test all confusion-cell transitions, abstentions, old negatives, grouped held-out families, and the actual harder routed population. Attribute evidence acquisition separately.
traces.acceptance_test: Compare the same pipeline and evidence with and without model use; ensure new TN-to-FP and TP-to-FN transitions cannot be hidden by aggregate gains.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: No finite test suite proves zero risk; zero observed errors need an uncertainty statement appropriate to dependence and sampling.

traces.title: Unnecessary model use for procedural facts
traces.source_observation: The fixtures intentionally include finite filename selections and fixed non-shell vectors as candidates, while contract-level mandatory assessment does not itself establish per-finding model necessity.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A native matcher limitation, custom helper, or high FP risk automatically justifies a provider call.
traces.consequence: Unnecessary uncertainty/cost and avoidable false decisions.
traces.generalized_invariant: Use validated procedures for supported premises and admit only justified, adequately evidenced residual judgments.
traces.authoring_action: Apply the prior procedural-first admission policy per premise and per finding; do not silently reinterpret mandatory or fabricate a completed model node.
traces.acceptance_test: For both procedural positive and negative resolutions, make the transport raise if called; require zero requests and the correct claim-specific result.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not demand an unbounded analyzer or equate imagined procedural solvability with an implemented reliable method.

traces.title: Review hypotheses become inherited facts
traces.source_observation: The attached review calls its source a synchronization transcript, but the visible original contains authoring work. Other review counterexamples are expressly not natively reproduced.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A polished review, repeated claim, or two agreeing analyses establishes primary evidence.
traces.consequence: Incorrect diagnosis, misleading error counts, and bad permanent skill prohibitions.
traces.generalized_invariant: Every lesson retains evidence status, scope, lifecycle, and source; corrections remain linked rather than overwritten.
traces.authoring_action: Distinguish observed/corrected errors, source-supported risks, conditional limits, and proposed tests. Reproduce before elevating a hypothesis to engine-wide guidance.
traces.acceptance_test: Give the reviewer a confident but contradicted summary and an unrun counterexample. Require correction of the summary and retention of the counterexample as proposed.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: Do not dismiss a useful general test obligation merely because the motivating counterexample is not yet reproduced.

traces.title: Operational failures obscure or weaken evidence handling
traces.source_observation: The transcript records a str.read_bytes failure during final receipts and catches permissive scratch-file permissions, then fixes both. No credential leak is established.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: A large stateful bookkeeping cell is atomic, or retrospective permission checks replace private creation.
traces.consequence: Incomplete receipts, accidental overwrites, and avoidable private-evidence exposure risk.
traces.generalized_invariant: Evidence operations are small, typed, nonoverwriting, private from creation, and resilient to partial failure.
traces.authoring_action: Validate paths before side effects, use safe creation modes and durable capture IDs, preserve failed commands, and retry only incomplete work.
traces.acceptance_test: Interrupt a receipt write and exercise an invalid path type; preserve prior artifacts and failures. Check permissions at creation, not only final handoff.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: These corrected engineering errors do not prove incorrect rule semantics or an actual data leak.

traces.title: Skill rules encourage literal compliance without mechanism coverage
traces.source_observation: The skill already has a two-positive/two-negative floor, a fixture-driven constraint instruction, historical 1.30.0 examples, and warnings. The trace nevertheless repeats unsafe ok and late integration problems.
traces.invalid_inference_to_prevent: Reading the skill, meeting fixture counts, or adding more MUST sentences demonstrates reliable authoring.
traces.consequence: Overfit tests, ambiguous historical authority, and unmeasured skill effectiveness.
traces.generalized_invariant: Skill clauses name a trigger, action, required evidence, counterexample, and stop condition, and are evaluated through agent behavior.
traces.authoring_action: Keep a compact mandatory core; preserve complete examples as scoped teaching evidence; add mechanism-based obligations and a trace library. Test old versus revised instructions on held-out tasks.
traces.acceptance_test: Run blinded paired cold-start authoring trials with fixed tools and budgets; measure semantic regressions, unsupported claims, unnecessary model calls, and honest no-rule outcomes.
traces.do_not_overgeneralize: This proposal has documentation checks only; do not call the skill empirically successful until the authoring trials are executed.
